messages:
ashley (acct-exec): Heads-up: POC customer blocked. Their app intermittently fails JSON.parse when using function-calling + json_mode non-streaming. They pasted a raw response that has extra trailing bytes after the JSON. Can we swarm?

sam (sales-engineer): Can you post the raw HTTP response (headers + body) and whether they use keep-alive / client retries?

ashley (acct-exec): Sample they sent:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  \"choices\": [ { \"message\": { \"name\": \"extract\", \"arguments\": \"{\\\"id\\\": 42, \\\"items\\\": [\\\"x\\\", \\\"y\\\"]}\" } } ]
}
--trailing-bytes--
```
They said model=redwood-medium-v1, streaming=false, max_tokens=1024, and they do client-side retries on 429/500. Also saw a 429 with X-Request-Id: req_z9ff.

tyler (ml-eng): If the client retries on the same connection while the previous response hasn't fully drained we sometimes see leftover bytes appended. Need the exact X-Request-Id(s) and the customer's raw payload + headers (content-length / transfer-encoding).

prashant (infra): Ops-bot, pull traces for req_z9ff and any adjacent request ids for that customer. Also quick triage: recommend they temporarily disable aggressive retries and use SDK-level dedupe.

ops-bot: Trace found -> req_z9ff mapped to worker-18. Related span req_z9fg. Worker log at 2026-03-21T03:12:11Z shows WARN: \"stream-terminate: leftover-bytes\".

tyler (ml-eng): That WARN matches a stream flush boundary bug we saw in staging. Short-term mitigations to give customer: (1) use a defensive sanitizer that extracts the first top-level JSON before JSON.parse, (2) enable streaming=true and parse as a stream, or (3) use SDK with idempotency to avoid duplicate retries.

sam (sales-engineer): They also asked: if they stop client retries how much would that affect billing? Need a short number.

prashant (infra): Short answer: duplicate retries can inflate token spend roughly proportional to retry rate. If 8-12% of requests retry, you could see up to ~8-12% extra token usage. SDK de-dup reduces that to near-zero.

ashley (acct-exec): They're also asking on the security questionnaire: will we retain raw prompts/responses during the POC? They want prompt+response retention <=30 days.

compliance-bot: For Dedicated deployments you can configure log retention and disable prompt logging. For hosted POC we can offer restricted retention under an enterprise agreement; I'll follow up via email.

tyler (ml-eng): Engineering plan: add a small guard in the worker HTTP shim to append a canonical delimiter for json_mode responses (e.g., \"\n---\n\") so clients can detect concatenation. Also add unit/integration tests that simulate keep-alive + client retries. Estimated: patch + unit tests 1-2h, staging validation 2h, canary 10% within same day, full rollout after monitoring window.

sam (sales-engineer): Can we drop a tiny Node sanitiser they can run immediately? If so paste it and I'll send to them.

prashant (infra): Quick triage snippet (not production):
```js
// naive sanitizer: return first top-level JSON object
function sanitize(respText) {
  const end = respText.indexOf('\n--'); // heuristic for their trailing marker
  const payload = end === -1 ? respText : respText.slice(0, end).trim();
  return JSON.parse(payload);
}
```

tyler (ml-eng): We'll still patch the shim; sanitizer is only a temporary workaround. After patch we'll add integration tests that open a single keep-alive connection, send two requests with a quick retry, and assert responses are separately parseable.

ashley (acct-exec): I'll tell customer: 1) we're on it and prioritized, 2) a short-term sanitizer + SDK dedupe option, 3) hotfix plan with canary and ETA, 4) compliance will confirm retention controls for POC. Scheduling a 4:30pm PT call to walk through. I'll post the full raw response and any more request ids when they send them. :thumbsup:

sam (sales-engineer): I'll prep the pricing blurb and join the call.

ops-bot: Noted: ticket created #POC-4987, linked traces req_z9ff, req_z9fg.

tyler (ml-eng): After rollout we'll monitor for any new \"stream-terminate: leftover-bytes\" WARNs and close the ticket if no further incidents for 48h.

ashley (acct-exec): Thanks team — keep me posted.
